title: Pseudolaric acid B exerts an antifungal effect and targets SIRT1 to ameliorate inflammation by regulating Nrf2/NF-kappaB pathways in fungal keratitis.
authors: Liu, Shuyi; Qin, Tao; Zou, Fengkai; Dong, He; Yu, Liang; Wang, Hai; Zhang, Lijun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌性角膜炎中PAB的抗真菌和抗炎作用，涉及SIRT1/Nrf2/NF-kappaB通路，仅含分子对接但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Fungal keratitis (FK) is a vision-threatening infection. We aimed to explore the antifungal and anti-inflammatory effects of pseudolaric acid B (PAB) on FK and the underlying mechanisms involved. Network pharmacology utilized to acquire the potential target genes, and silent information regulator 1 (SIRT1) was consistently downregulated in Gene Expression Omnibus dataset and clinical samples. Molecular docking analysis showed that PAB and SIRT1 had good binding activity. No toxicity was observed in vivo and in vitro with a PAB concentration below 0.3 muM. PAB exerted its antifungal activity by destroying the integrity of hyphae, and alleviated the severity of FK in rats by decreasing clinical scores, fungal burden and inhibiting inflammatory cell infiltration. PAB increased SIRT1 to regulate the crosstalk between nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB), decreasing the levels of inflammatory cytokines tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha, interleukin (IL)-1beta, and IL-6; and pattern recognition receptors, C-type lectin domain containing 7A (Dectin-1), lectin-like oxidized low-density lipoprotein receptor 1 (LOX-1), toll like receptor (TLR)-2, and TLR4 both in vivo and in vitro. However, this anti-inflammatory effect of PAB was abolished by the SIRT1 inhibitor EX527. This study provides new evidence that PAB has antifungal and anti-inflammatory effects in FK and may provide a novel therapeutic strategy for the treatment of FK.
abstract_zh: 真菌性角膜炎（FK）是一种威胁视力的感染。我们旨在探讨假松酸B（PAB）对FK的抗真菌和抗炎作用及其潜在机制。通过网络药理学获取潜在靶基因，沉默信息调节因子1（SIRT1）在基因表达综合数据库数据集和临床样本中持续下调。分子对接分析显示PAB与SIRT1具有良好的结合活性。在体内和体外，PAB浓度低于0.3 μM时未观察到毒性。PAB通过破坏菌丝完整性发挥其抗真菌活性，并通过降低临床评分、真菌负荷及抑制炎症细胞浸润来减轻大鼠FK的严重程度。PAB上调SIRT1以调节核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）与核因子κB（NF-κB）之间的相互作用，降低炎症细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α、白细胞介素（IL）-1β和IL-6的水平；以及模式识别受体C型凝集素结构域含7A（Dectin-1）、凝集素样氧化低密度脂蛋白受体1（LOX-1）、Toll样受体（TLR）-2和TLR4在体内和体外均有所降低。然而，PAB的这种抗炎作用被SIRT1抑制剂EX527所消除。本研究提供了新证据，表明PAB在FK中具有抗真菌和抗炎作用，并可能为FK的治疗提供一种新的策略。
